# Unit 6: Virtualization & File System Management

## Hypervisors & Containers
Virtualization abstracts hardware resources:
- Type 1 Hypervisor (Bare-Metal): Runs directly on host hardware (e.g., Xen, VMware ESXi).
- Type 2 Hypervisor (Hosted): Runs on top of a host operating system (e.g., VirtualBox).
- Container Virtualization: Uses OS-level primitives (Linux namespaces for isolation and cgroups for resource limits) to run isolated application environments without hypervisor overhead.

## File Systems & Journaling
File systems organize storage blocks into files and directories. Journaling file systems use Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) to record metadata changes before writing to main disk blocks, allowing fast crash recovery without running full fsck checks.
